title: Single-issue campaigns
text: Forty years of bans, boycotts and celebrity campaigns, and animal use by humans has only increased. A single-issue campaign targets one form of animal use, fur, veal, foie gras, circuses, and asks the public to oppose that one thing. The principle that animals exist for human use is left untouched. So the industry pivots, the use continues, and the public walks away feeling absolved. Take fur. Over forty years of campaigns, more than twenty countries banned fur farming, and the number of industries that stopped using animals as a result is zero. Brands dropped fur and picked up cow skin, sheep wool and exotic skins instead. The UK banned veal crates in 1990, and the result was rose veal: same industry, same calves killed, new welfare branding. You cannot say animals are not ours to use and then campaign for just not like this. Veganism is the baseline, not the destination.
